subject: literacy
concept: Writing a simple source citation identifying where information came from
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student fills in a simple citation template (title, source, date) using provided source information
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a piece of information to its correct source citation
exercise.abstract: Student writes a basic citation for a fact used in their own research notes

misconception_flags: omits key citation information (source name or date)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
